notes.title: Play GBA version on the SteamDeck
notes.content:
The GBA version is also playable on SteamDeck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879650/3563d21f91ae4ab3155cd4e55479cfaa6b0842ce.png[/img]

You need getting the RetroArch from the Steam Store.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1118310/RetroArch

Also needed the mGBA core.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227448/RetroArch__mGBA/

However, you must first copy the ROM files under /home/deck as follows:
[olist]
[*] Switch to desktop mode.
[*] Launch the desktop Steam client.
[*] Find the ROM file in the “Browse local files” section of Battle Marine.
[*] Press Y to copy the ROM file
[*] Go to your home document.
[*] Press the X button and tap the "Paest" soft key.
[/olist]

[i]We have written this article to help you if you want to play only with SteamDeck, although we do not think you will have any doubts if you are using a PC.[/i]

notes.title: GBA version added
notes.content:
A GBA version of Battle Marine (ROM file) has been added as a purchase bonus for the Steam version of Battle Marine.

The GBA version of Battle Marine can be played on an emulator such as mGBA.
https://mgba.io/

If you have a GBXCart RW and the corresponding Flash ROM cartridge (32KB FRAM or SRAM required), you can also play on the actual device.
[previewyoutube=22XMAd616tU;full][/previewyoutube]

GBA ROM files can be found in the Steam client by opening “Browse local files” under “Manage”.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44879650/38e9bc600493efb69a8e9d358cea6dc5f1b45a09.png[/img]

A detailed description of the GBA version is given in README-en.txt in bmarine_gba.zip.

Have fun!

notes.title: Battle Marine for GBA coming soon!
notes.content:
We will soon be updating Battle Marine to distribute the ROM file of the GBA version of Battle Marine as a bonus for purchasing the game on Steam.

The GBA port is coming along very nicely and is ready for release once the ending and balance adjustments are completed.
[previewyoutube=22XMAd616tU;full][/previewyoutube]

We will probably be able to update the game by the end of June 2025.

The distribution method will be the same as the GBA version of Battle AirForce and will be made available without additional charges.

notes.title: Support for SteamDeck
notes.content: We have confirmed that when playing with SteamDeck, there is line noise on the screen when the screen filter is enabled, so we have made a correction to turn off the screen filter in the default settings on new installations.

notes.title: Battle AirForce to be released in April 2025
notes.content:
Battle AirForce, a vertical-scrolling bullet-hell STG set three years after Battle Marine, is scheduled for release in April 2024.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476490/Battle_AirForce/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3476490/Battle_AirForce/[/url]

This title is an orthodox vertical scrolling barrage STG, but you may find evolution from Battle Marine in many places.

We are planning a [b]40% off[/b] release sale for the first week after release, so if you are interested, please register your wish list.

notes.title: Supports Apple Silicon
notes.content: Previously, Battle Marine failed to start on Macs with Apple Silicon due to SDL2 runtime dependency issues, but by statically linking SDL2, it can now be started successfully.

notes.title: Rapid auto fire & Changed default GPU
notes.content:
[b]Support Rapid Auto-Fire (Windows, Linux, macOS)[/b]

Added shot firing function for keyboard input.
The c key is assigned by default.
It can be customized to any key with CTRL+K (Windows) or config.json (Linux/macOS).

[b]bugfix: Keyboard configuration does not saved (Windows)[/b]

A bug in the Windows version that caused keyboard assignment settings to be reset to default settings after rebooting, has been addressed.

[b]Changed default GPU (Linux)[/b]

The default GPU at startup has been changed from OpenGL to Vulkan.
In environments where Vulkan is not available, OpenGL is used as before.
In environments where OpenGL is not available, software rendering can be used by specifying the startup option: -g None

[b]Changed default GPU (macOS)[/b]

The default GPU at startup has been changed from OpenGL to Metal.
On environments where Metal is not available, OpenGL is used as before.
On environments where OpenGL is not available, software rendering can be used by specifying the startup option: -g None

notes.title: Support configuration for Linux and macOS
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem that could cause rendering errors in some environments.
[*]Fixed a problem that could cause a crash during ELF relocation.
[*]Fixed a problem that could cause a crash when exiting the game
[*]Customization of behavior settings is now supported.
[/list]

[b]How to customize the operation settings[/b]

When you launch Battle Marine after this update, a configuration file called config.json will be generated.
The config.json file is saved under the directory opened by opening the Battle Marine page in the Steam client and selecting "Settings Icon" > "Manage" > "Browse local files".

You can customize the following items:
[list]
[*]graphic.isFullScreen: true = full screen, false = window mode
[*]graphic.isScanline: true = with screen effects, false = without screen effects
[*]gaphic.windowHeight: height of the screen in window mode 
[*]gaphic.windowWidth: width of the screen in window mode
[*]sound.volumeBgm: Volume of background music (0-100)
[*]sound.volumeSe: Volume of sound effect (0-100)
[*]keyboard.a: Key code for A button (jump)
[*]keyboard.b: key code for B button (fire)
[*]keyboard.start: key code for START button (pause)
[*]keyboard.select: key code for SELECT button (n/a)
[*]keyboard.up: key code for up button
[*]keyboard.down: key code for down button
[*]keyboard.left: Key code for left button
[*]keyboard.right: Key code for right button
[*]keyboard.reset: Reset button key code
[*]keyboard.quit: Key code for quit button
[/list]

The keycode specifies the SDL keycode.
https://wiki.libsdl.org/SDL2/SDLKeycodeLookup

notes.title: Friend Score Ranking, Quick Restart and other
notes.content:
The following features have been added

[b]1) In-game display of friend score ranking[/b]

Friend score rankings can now be displayed from "SCORE RANKING" in the title.

Note: Non-ASCII code strings will be replaced with "? in the title.

[b]2) Restarting the game when pausing is now possible.[/b]

When pausing during a game, you can now select RESUME (restart the game) or RESTART (start the game over from the beginning).

[b]3) ON/OFF toggle for scan line screen filter[/b] (*on Windows only)

It is now possible to toggle the screen scanline filter ON/OFF by pressing CTRL+L or the menu item "Screen" -> "Toggle ScanLine filter".

notes.title: Update for Windows
notes.content:
The following update was made to the Windows version only

[b]1) Fixed issue with faster than 60Hz displays.[/b]

Because the game was always controlled by the vertical synchronization of the screen (V-SYNC), the game would run faster when played on a display with a faster screen refresh interval, such as 144Hz.
Note1: The fix is to adjust the timing by V-SYNC as before when the screen refresh interval is 60Hz, and by Sleep in other cases.
Note2: This problem should not occur on Linux and macOS because they always use Sleep to adjust timing.

[b]2) Added volume sliders for background music and sound effects.[/b]

The volume balance of background music and sound effects can now be adjusted by CTRL+V or "Sound" -> "Volume Control" in the menu.

notes.title: Added leaderboard for friend ranking
notes.content: We have released a version that supports leaderboards where you can compete with your friends in the Steam community for scores.
